{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS188 |prevtitle=Lombre Larceny |nextcode=PS190 |nexttitle=Blowing Past Nosepass I |series=Ruby & Sapphire |colorscheme=Hoenn}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Mowing Down Ludicolo |subtitle=Battle Against the Blue Uniforms |title_ja=VS ルンパッパ |title_ro=VS Runpappa |image=PS189.png |scheme=Ruby & Sapphire |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 189 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|15}} |pub2=VIZ Media full volume |pub2-data=Adventure 189 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|15}} |location=[[Petalburg Woods]] }} '''Mowing Down Ludicolo''' (Japanese: '''VS ルンパッパ''' ''VS {{tt|Runpappa|Ludicolo}}''), titled '''VS Ludicolo''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 189th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the ninth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Ruby & Sapphire}}. It is subtitled '''Battle Against the Blue Uniforms''' (Japanese: '''対決　青装束''' ''Showdown Against the Blue Uniforms'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Clash With the Team in Blue''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Sapphire}} sends out [[Rono]] and [[Chic]] to battle the three Pokémon that have leaped from the broken fountain. They manage to pin down the {{p|Sharpedo}} and {{p|Carvanha}}, but the {{p|Lombre}} attacks [[Mr. Stone]] and steals a machine from his pockets before running off. The Sharpedo and Carvanha run off too, forcing Sapphire to chase after them with Mr. Stone being carried on her back. As Sapphire, [[Gabby and Ty|Gabby, and Ty]] chase after the Pokémon, they realize that the attack was too coordinated to be a coincidence, meaning that the attackers were given orders. They chase the Pokémon into the [[Petalburg Woods]], but Sapphire reveals that she is much more energetic in nature, allowing her to locate the three thieves. Noticing that one of their Pokémon is missing, Sapphire sees that the {{p|Lombre}} had snuck up behind them and it attacks Gabby and Ty. Sapphire tries to attack, but one of the thieves reveals that her Pokémon were injured from her {{p|Sharpedo}}'s {{a|Rough Skin}}. But, to give them an advantage, the female thief, Shelly, gives her Lombre a [[Water Stone]] to [[Evolution|evolve]] into a {{p|Ludicolo}}, thus allowing it to easily defeat Sapphire's Pokémon. The thieves reveal that Mr. Stone actually had the component to the [[Submarine Explorer 1]] which he was going to deliver whilst pretending to be on a stroll. Since they now have the component, the thieves prepare to kill Sapphire and company in order to silence her. Before Sapphire can react, Mr. Stone's Castform helps by giving her Chic a boost in strength with {{m|Sunny Day}}, allowing her to beat Shelly's Ludicolo. Having escaped, Sapphire takes the injured Mr. Stone, Gabby, and Ty to [[Rustboro City]]. Gabby thanks Sapphire for saving them, but Sapphire says that it was Castform who really saved them with its Sunny Day. Mr. Stone comes to, and Sapphire apologizes for not being able to get the component back for him. Before he faints again, Mr. Stone gives Sapphire a [[letter]] to give to his son, {{Steven}}. After he falls unconscious again, Sapphire promises to deliver the letter to his son. ==Major events== * [[Gabby and Ty]] are attacked by [[Shelly]]'s {{p|Ludicolo}}. * {{adv|Sapphire}} defeats [[Team Aqua]], but they successfully steal the [[Devon Parts|Devon Goods]]. * [[Mr. Stone]] gives Sapphire a letter for {{Steven}}. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Ludicolo}} * {{p|Castform}} (Sunny Form) ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Sapphire}} * [[Archie]] * [[Mr. Stone]] * [[Gabby and Ty]] * [[Shelly]] * [[Matt]] * {{adv|Amber}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Aron}} ([[Rono]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Torchic}} ([[Chic]]; {{adv|Sapphire}}'s) * {{p|Castform}} ([[Fofo|Mr. Stone]]'s; {{DL|List of Pokémon with form differences|Castform|Normal and Sunny Forms}}) * {{p|Lombre}} ([[Shelly]]'s; evolves) * {{p|Ludicolo}} ([[Shelly]]'s; newly evolved; debut) * {{p|Carvanha}} ({{adv|Amber}}'s) * {{p|Sharpedo}} ([[Matt]]'s) * {{p|Mantine}} ([[Team Aqua]]'s) * {{p|Qwilfish}} ([[Team Aqua]]'s) * {{p|Corsola}} ([[Team Aqua]]'s) * {{p|Remoraid}} ([[Team Aqua]]'s) * {{p|Castform}} (All Forms; fantasy) ==Trivia== ===Errors=== * In the [[Chuang Yi]] version, [[Team Aqua]] mistakenly calls {{m|Secret Power}} a different move, {{m|Hidden Power}}. ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color=9999FF|bordercolor=FF7777 |zh_cmn={{tt|VS 樂天河童|VS Ludicolo}} (Taiwan)
